{{Quote|4724, how does the west end check out?|A B1 battle droid requests a report from 4724|<ref name="DoP" />}}
'''4724''' was a member of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. 4724 was stationed at the west end of a [[CIS mobile command center/Legends|CIS mobile command center]] after [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
[[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] arrived on [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and [[Gender/Legends|he]] brought [[Confederacy military/Legends|Separatist forces]] with him to the [[Planet/Legends|world]]. While on duty on Maridun, 4724 was guarding the west end of a [[Separatist command center/Legends|Separatist command center]] established by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly]] and [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] infiltrated the base, and while there Rex, Bly, and Skywalker took out [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s in a Separatist [[command center]] inside as one of the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in it requested a report from 4724.
